test_to_float_tensor_conversion: test converting numpy arrays of shape HW, HWC, and NHWC to PyTorch float tensors using to_float_tensor
test_to_numpy_roundtrip: test round-trip conversion from numpy array to float tensor and back to numpy using to_numpy
test_uint8_tensor_conversion: test converting uint8 numpy arrays scaled to 0-255 range into float tensors via to_float_tensor
test_to_numpy_dtype_preservation: test that to_numpy correctly restores the original dtype including uint8 and float32
test_multi_dimensional_array_conversion: test 2D, 3D, and 4D numpy array conversions through to_float_tensor and to_numpy utilities
